document_id: AEMET 2024 - ESTUDIO SOBRE LA SITUACIÓN DE LLUVIAS INTENSAS

hazards.source_text: warnings of Tarragona are prolonged to include the morning of the day 4. On the 4th at 00:47 hours the notice of immediate prediction of precipitation of 40 mm in an hour on the north coast of Tarragona.The accumulated one was also raised in twelve hours to 90 mm for this area, although it remained the yellow level. At 1:17 hours the yellow warnings of Prelithoral north of Tarragona were raised to orange, with accumulated 40 mm in an hour and 120 mm in twelve hours. The yellow warning of precipitation of Litoral north of Tarragona was raised to the orange level with 150 mm in 12 hours.

hazards.source_text: the last episode has broken the national record of the intensity of the precipitation accumulated in one, six and twelve hours. The maximum time data, of 185 mm, triples to the value of 60 mm used as threshold for the definition of torrentiality, being also 26 mm higher than the maximum value previously observed in the town of Vinaròs (Castellón) on 19 October 2018.
